Lines.en: Wahaha! Now that SansGrinder is trapped in a space-time paradox, I am free to execute my devilish plan - to execute YOU!
Lines.zh: 哇哈哈！现在SansGrinder被困在了时空悖论中，我终于可以接着执行我邪恶的计划了——处决你！

Lines.en: LOOK at all those gorgeous creations! I could never have invented those without the help of YOU GUYS!
Lines.zh: 看看这些强大的僵尸吧！若不是你们，我完全不可能发明出这么强大的僵尸！

Lines.en: Now that the table has turned against you, prepare for your very own DEMISE!
Lines.zh: 形势已经逆转了，准备受死吧！

Lines.en: Warning! The instabilities in this rift has been building up!
Lines.zh: 警告！多次时空穿梭导致的不稳定性正在累加！

Lines.en: There's too much timeline warping, too much time travelling, too much parallel universe  connections - this rift has been breached and could collapse at any moment!
Lines.zh: 太多次时间线扭曲、太多时空穿梭、太多平行宇宙串联，这个裂缝随时可能崩塌！

Lines.en: Collapse?! What will happen to us if we are still in the rift as it collapses?
Lines.zh: 坍塌！？如果裂缝坍塌时我们还在里面会发生什么？

Lines.en: I..... I don't know, User Dave......
Neighbour! Defeat Dr. Zomboss as soon as possible! We MUST evacuate before it's too late!
Lines.zh: 邻居！请你尽快打败僵尸博士！我们必须尽快撤离！

Lines.en: Well done, neighbour! Let's get out of here before it's too late!
Lines.zh: 干的好，邻居！我们快撤离！

Lines.en: Hey! Where are y'all going! I got words to say!
Lines.zh: 嘿！你们去干啥了！我还有话说！

Lines.en: Wha-what!?! How... how are those portals... I did not summon those...
Lines.zh: 什-什么！？这些传送门……我可没召唤这些……

Lines.en: This can't be good, I'm out of here
Lines.zh: 这可不妙，我还是先撤了
